key_findings: Electroacupuncture at ST36 reduced paw IL-1β, TNF-α and NLRP3 and M1 marker iNOS in CFA mice, and raised CD206 and splenic Treg proportion.
EA relieved mechanical and heat hyperalgesia and paw swelling.
